title: Mia and the Rocking Horse
keywords: Anh trai vượt ngàn chông gai
segments: One warm autumn afternoon, Mia found Uncle Leo in his cozy woodworking shed. He was not carving, but sitting sadly, holding his back. "My back hurts too much, Mia," he sighed, looking at the unfinished wooden rocking horse. "I cannot finish it for the Children's Day festival." Mia saw his sadness and the important project left undone.

Because of this, Mia felt a strong desire to help her sad uncle. She knew the rocking horse was important. After Uncle Leo rested, Mia quietly snuck into the shed. She picked up a sanding block, hoping to smooth the wood. But it was much heavier and rougher than she expected. Woodworking was clearly harder than it looked!

Because of this, Mia realized the sanding block was too difficult. She remembered her mom often helped with crafts. Mia decided to ask her for advice. Her mom showed Mia a lighter sanding sponge and how to rub gently. With these child-friendly tools, Mia slowly smoothed the horse's back, feeling a little more hopeful.

After that, Mia felt confident. She decided to try attaching the horse's tail. Carefully, she picked up a small tool. But her hand slipped! The tool scratched the horse's smooth back. Mia's heart sank. Just then, Uncle Leo walked in, looking a little better. He saw the scratch. "Don't worry, Mia," he said kindly. "We can fix it together.

After that, Uncle Leo helped Mia smooth out the scratch. He showed her how to gently sand and polish the wood. Together, they made it disappear! Mia felt so happy. She worked hard, adding the mane and tail. Finally, the beautiful rocking horse was finished. Uncle Leo smiled, his eyes shining with pride. He gave Mia a big, warm hug.

After that, Uncle Leo proudly showed the finished rocking horse to the whole family. Everyone gathered in the shed, amazed by Mia's hard work. They celebrated her creativity and problem-solving. Mia felt a wave of happiness as her family gave her a big group hug, full of love and pride. The rocking horse was ready for the festival!
endWrap: This is the end of Mia's secret mission. She learned a lot about woodworking and family love. Her efforts made everyone happy.
